task.title: Relics: record in the index when a relic's history is cut short
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M27). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

When a relic's history is cut short by a missing commit, the index drops that relic's operation rows and records nothing about it. A reader of the index cannot tell "no history" from "history unknown".

## Wanted

Record that the history is incomplete, so a reader can say so.

## Done when

- A relic with a missing commit is marked in the index as having incomplete history.
- History output for that relic says the history is incomplete; it does not show an empty list.

## Notes

Do this with "Relics: show history and diffs", which is the first reader of these rows.
